title: Reports
blurb: Something happened. Say what, and when.

questions.label: What happened?
questions.help: In your own words. What you saw, who was involved, what happened next.

questions.label: Where?
questions.help: The place, the street, or as near as you can say.

questions.label: Did you see it yourself?
options: I saw it online or in the news

questions.label: Do you have photos, video, audio or documents of this?
questions.help: Nothing is uploaded by answering this. It only tells us something exists, so we can ask you for it if it turns out to matter.

questions.label: What is it of?
questions.help: One line. 'Thirty seconds of the queue outside', or 'a photo of the notice on the door'.
